blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A large language model maintains conversational content in an external storage that is outside the model and grows as the dialogue continues. This work assumes an environment where a language model has no external memory and no prior knowledge of the future question or its answer. The motivation is to research whether a dialogue can be stored in the model parameters and later answer a question about it. This work proposes self-keyed in-parameter memorization (SKIM), a closed-form method in which the model generates its own questions about each dialogue turn and writes those questions into its parameters as the keys that later retrieve the turn's content. Generating many varied questions for each turn allows a later user question to match one even when phrased differently, and its answer is recalled from the parameters alone. Evaluated on five language models, SKIM recalls most stored dialogue turns from later user questions, and it answers from the model parameters without any external storage.
blocks.zh: 一个大型语言模型在模型外的外置存储器中保持对话内容,随着对话的继续而增长. 这部作品假设一个语言模型没有外部记忆,也没有对未来问题或答案的事先了解的环境. 其动机是研究一个对话是否能够被存储在模型参数中,并随后回答一个有关它的问题. 这部作品提出了自键式的参数内计量法(SKIM),这是一种闭合式方法,模型在这种方法中会生成自己对每个对话框的疑问,并将这些问题转换成其参数来作为后来取回转动内容的键. 为每个转弯生成许多不同的问题,即使措辞不同,也允许后期的用户问题匹配一个,其答案仅从参数中回忆. 在评价了五个语言模型后,SKIM回顾了大多数被存储的对话框从后来的用户提问中转出,它从模型参数中解答而没有任何外部存储.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent large language models (LLMs) serve as conversational assistants and their conversations often run for many exchanges ( Petroni et al. 2019 ; Roberts et al. 2020 ; De Cao et al. 2021 ; Kwon et al. 2023 ) .
As a conversation lengthens, answering well often depends on recalling something the user mentioned much earlier ( Xu et al. 2022 ; Packer et al. 2023 ; Wu et al. 2025 ) .
However, language models keep the dialogue not in their parameters but in a key-value (KV) cache or an external retrieval store that grows as the history accumulates.
The KV cache stores the attention keys and values of every past token, sparing the model from recomputing them at each step ( Vaswani et al. 2017 ; Shazeer 2019 ; Kwon et al. 2023 ) .
Its size grows proportionately to the length of the history and the generated tokens accumulate in the KV cache. Both memory use and inference cost rise as more turns arrive ( Pope et al. 2022 ; Dao et al. 2022 ) .
Instead, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) stores the dialogue in an external index and searches it for relevant passages at each question, placing them in the context ( Lewis et al. 2020 ; Lewis et al. 2021 ) .
The answer then depends on whether the index holds the right passage and whether the question was turned into an effective search query ( Guu et al. 2020 ; Maharana et al. 2024 ) .
Based on these observations, this work asks whether a frozen model can internalize a dialogue as it unfolds and later answer a question about it from its parameters alone.
The aim is to establish whether such internalization is feasible at all, rather than to improve on retrieval or long-context systems that already answer from external memory.
blocks.zh:
近期的大型语言模型(LLMs)担任对话助理,他们的谈话经常进行许多交流(Petroni等人. 2019; Roberts et al. 2020; 德曹等编. 2021; Kwon et al. 2023 ).
作为对话的延长,答案往往取决于用户先前提到的事情(徐等人)。 2022; Packer et al. 2023; 吴等 2025).
然而,语言模型不把对话框保存在它们的参数中,而是保存在密钥值(KV)缓存或外部检索商店中,随着历史的积累而增长.
KV缓存存储了每一个过去符号的注意键和值,避免了模型在每一步重构它们(Vaswani等人,2017年;Shazeer 2019年;Kwon等人,2023年).
其大小与历史长度成比例增长,生成的符在KV缓存中积累. 随着更多转弯的到来,记忆的使用和推论成本都上升(Pope et al. 2022; Dao et al. 2022 ).
相反,检索增强生成(RAG)将对话框存储在外部索引中,并在每个问题上搜索相关段落,将其置于上下文中(Lewis et al. 2020; Lewis et al. 2021 (英语).
然后答案取决于索引是否持有正确的段落,以及这个问题是否变成了有效的搜索查询(Guu等人. 2020; Maharana et al. 2024 (英语).
基于这些观察,本作询问一个被冻结的模型能否在对话展开时将对话内部化,后来仅从其参数中解答关于它的问题.
目的是确定这种内部化是否完全可行,而不是改进已经从外部内存中解答的检索或长文本系统.

blocks.en:
Prior studies aim to store a model’s memory in its parameters rather than in an external buffer ( Meng et al. 2022a ; Meng et al. 2022b ; Wang et al. 2024 ; Fang et al. 2025 ) .
Weight editing is one such approach that writes a fact directly into the parameters ( Mitchell et al. 2022 ; Meng et al. 2022a ; Meng et al. 2022b ) .
Given a subject and a relation, such as a person and their birthplace, these methods compute a closed-form update to one or a few feed-forward projections that causes the model to output the intended object ( Meng et al. 2022a ; Meng et al. 2022b ) .
A null-space projection allows many such edits to accumulate without overwriting one another ( Fang et al. 2025 ) .
However, this approach rests on two assumptions that conversational memory does not satisfy.
First, the object to store must be provided as a label because the update is solved to reproduce that object at the edited site ( Meng et al. 2022a ; Meng et al. 2022b ) .
Because no such label exists in a dialogue, the model must itself determine which part of a raw user turn should be stored.
Second, a fixed cue that is typically the subject and relation must be known in advance when constructing the edit ( Meng et al. 2022a ; Meng et al. 2022b ) .
In a dialogue, there is no fixed cue to install because the later question is unknown when the turn is stored and may be phrased in unforeseen ways.
Long-context models and retrieval systems avoid both assumptions, but they retain the dialogue outside the parameters ( Lewis et al. 2021 ) , in a cache or an index that grows as turns accumulate ( Maharana et al. 2024 ; Kwon et al. 2023 ) .
Thus, editing requires supervision that a dialogue cannot provide, whereas external buffers avoid that supervision only by incurring an ever-growing storage cost ( Kwon et al. 2023 ; Maharana et al. 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
以前的研究旨在将模型的内存储存在其参数中而不是放在外部缓冲器中(Meng等人,2022a; 孟 al等编. 2022b; 王等编. 2024; Fang等人著. 2025).
重量编辑是将事实直接写入参数的一种方法(Mitchell et al. 2022; Meng等人 2022a; Meng等人 2022b.).
鉴于一个主题和一种关系,例如一个人及其出生地,这些方法计算出一个或几个供料预测的封闭式更新,导致模型输出预定对象(Meng等人,2022a); 孟 et等2022b. ).
空空投影使得许多这样的编辑可以互相累积而不互相重叠(Fang et al. 2025).
然而,这种方法基于对话记忆不能满足的两个假设.
首先,存储对象必须作为标签提供,因为更新的解决是为了在编辑过的网站上复制该对象(Meng等人,2022a; 孟 et等2022b. ).
因为对话中没有这样的标签,所以模型本身必须确定原始用户转弯的哪个部分应该存储.
第二,在构建编辑时必须事先知道通常属于主题和关系的固定提示(Meng等人,2022a); 孟 et等2022b. ).
在对话中,没有固定的提示可以安装,因为后一个问题在存储转弯时未知,并且可能用无法预料的方式表达.
长文本模型和检索系统都避免了这两种假设,但它们保留了参数外的对话框(Lewis et al. 2021),在缓存或索引中随着转弯积累而增长(Maharana et al. 2024; Kwon et al. 2023 (英语).
因此,编辑需要监督,而对话不能提供,而外部缓冲只能通过产生不断增加的存储成本来避免这种监督(Kwon等人,第1段)。 2023; 马哈拉纳等人 2024 ).

blocks.en:
Prior work established that the feed-forward layers of a transformer store factual associations and recall them at inference, and that a band of middle layers is where such facts are most readily located and edited ( Geva et al. 2021 ; Dai et al. 2022 ; Meng et al. 2022a ; Geva et al. 2023 ) .
Building on that finding, this work writes each user turn into the down-projection of one mid-to-late feed-forward layer by a closed-form rule.
The target layer is chosen per model and a later question is answered from the edited parameters alone.
This work assumes an environment where a frozen model has no external memory and no access to the future question or its answer when it stores a turn, which makes a direct comparison to other editing methods difficult.
The setting imposes four constraints, namely no gradient fine-tuning, no external memory at recall, a per-turn cost independent of the number of stored turns, and preserved general behavior.
This work forgoes the KV cache despite its usefulness and keeps the dialogue in the parameters ( Vaswani et al. 2017 ; Shazeer 2019 ) .
Because the model has no future question or answer, it must produce from the turn alone the object and cue that weight editing receives but a dialogue cannot provide.

基于这一发现,本作品将每个用户通过一个封闭式规则,变成一个中晚期反馈层的下投影。
目标层是每个模型选择的,一个后期的问题仅从编辑过的参数中解答.
这部作品假设一个被冻结的模型在存储转盘时没有外部内存,无法访问未来的问题或答案的环境,这使得与其他编辑方法的直接比较变得困难.
设置有四个制约因素,即没有梯度微调,没有外部记忆回溯,每个转弯成本独立于存储转弯次数,并保留了一般行为.
这项工作放弃了KV缓存,尽管其有用,并将对话框保留在参数中(Vaswani等人,2017年;Shazeer 2019年).
由于该模型没有未来的问答,它必须从转弯单独产生对象并提示重量编辑收到但对话不能提供。

blocks.en:
This work proposes a Self-Keyed In-parameter Memorization approach, called Skim , that allows a frozen model to store a turn and later recall it without the ground-truth answer or the future question.
The proposed Skim operates on spans, each a short contiguous piece of a turn’s text. Skim proceeds in three stages, namely (i) extracting candidate spans from the raw turn, (ii) generating for each span several questions that the span answers and keeping the ones that best separate that span from its rivals in the same turn, and (iii) installing every question–span pair into one projection by a joint closed-form edit.
The generated questions take the place of the fixed subject–relation input that prior editing must be given in advance. Because many diverse questions serve as keys for each span, a later user question resembles one of them even when phrased differently, and the question itself selects the right span at recall.
The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows. • This work aims to retain a dialogue and answer a later question about it in an environment without external memory, neither a KV cache nor a retrieval store. • This work proposes Skim , a closed-form method that internalizes each turn into the model parameters without the ground-truth answer or the future question, using self-generated questions as keys for its stored spans. • This work shows that Skim stores a dialogue as its turns arrive one at a time and reaches the recall of a single batch edit without the forgetting that sequential edits cause. • Evaluated on five language models, Skim recalls stored dialogue turns at a five-model mean of 63.1% and 75.0% on the strongest model, well above the no-cache floor that removes all memory.

blocks.en: Problem Setting and Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 问题设置和初步

blocks.en:
Current language models keep their parameters fixed and hold each conversation in an external memory that grows as the dialogue lengthens ( Lewis et al. 2021 ; Maharana et al. 2024 ) .
This paper asks whether a frozen model can hold the conversation in its parameters instead of an external memory, and answer later questions from them.
The assumed scenario is as follows.
A stream of user turns u 1 , … , u N u_{1},\dots,u_{N} arrives, and each u i u_{i} states a fact that some later question q i q_{i} asks about, whose answer is a i a_{i} .
The language model stores each turn in its parameters as it arrives, and it is more constrained than the external store it replaces.
A cache or a retrieval index maintains a turn in full and delays every decision until the query arrives.
Instead, the model must determine from the turn itself what to store.
It is given neither the later question q i q_{i} that would identify the relevant content nor the answer a i a_{i} that would specify the target.
The phrasing of the later question may also be unanticipated.
When the later question arrives, the model receives it as the only input and must generate the answer.
No session text, cache, or retrieval index remains available.
Four constraints hold throughout.
Storing a turn uses no gradient fine-tuning, its cost does not grow as more turns are stored, recall is a single forward pass, and the edit must leave the general behavior of the model intact.

blocks.en: Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 拟议方法

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 1 , Skim extracts candidate spans as the values to store, generates questions about each span as the keys that address them, and installs the pairs into one feed-forward layer by the closed-form joint edit.
The first two stages use the frozen model only to generate and rank candidates, and only the third stage changes a parameter.
At recall, the model answers the user question from its parameters.

blocks.en: Self-Keyed Construction
blocks.zh: 自眼建筑

blocks.en:
The frozen language model produces short answer phrases when prompted to list the specific facts the turn u u states. Skim also takes the turn’s quoted titles and capitalized entity phrases directly from its text.
These candidates are filtered to short spans of a few words rather than the whole utterance and form the candidate value set 𝒮 ⁡ ( u ) \mathcal{S}(u) .
The model then ranks each span s ∈ 𝒮 ⁡ ( u ) s\in\mathcal{S}(u) answer-free by ρ ⁡ ( s ) = 𝔼 q ∼ Q 0 ​ ( s ) ​ [ log ⁡ p M ​ ( s ∣ q , u ) ] + β ​ π ​ ( s ) , \rho(s)\;=\;\mathbb{E}_{q\sim Q_{0}(s)}\!\big[\log p_{M}(s\mid q,u)\big]\;+\;\beta\,\pi(s), (3) where Q 0 ​ ( s ) Q_{0}(s) is a set of self-questions the model generates for s s , and p M ​ ( x ∣ y ) p_{M}(x\mid y) is the probability the model M M assigns to a span x x as the continuation of a prompt y y .
The first term rewards a span the model can recover from its own questions about it, which is what later makes the span addressable.
The second term is the specificity prior π ⁡ ( s ) \pi(s) that equals the span’s negative log-probability given a neutral prompt and rewards a rare span that a later question is more likely to ask about.
The coefficient β \beta balances recoverability against specificity.
When a turn is stored, the model does not yet know which span the later question will ask about, and the single highest- ρ \rho span is often not that one.
Keeping top- k k spans as candidate values therefore defers the choice to recall time, where the later question retrieves the span that matches it.

blocks.en: Mitigating Forgetting from Sequential Edits
blocks.zh: 从顺序编辑中减轻遗忘

blocks.en:
A dialogue’s turns arrive one at a time and each is written into the parameters as it arrives before any later turn is available.
Such a memory is useful only if two demands are met.
The first demand is that a new write leave the already stored turns intact because a growing sequence of edits can otherwise interfere and erase them.
The second is that the memory the edit occupies stay fixed in size however long the dialogue runs which a growing cache cannot offer.
Meeting both while turns still arrive is not automatic because an edit that keeps growing as new turns come can disturb the turns already stored.
The reference point is a batch edit that solves Eq. ( 2 ) once on the complete set of pairs ( Meng et al. 2022b ) and is the strongest result the closed-form rule can reach. Skim reproduces this same Δ ​ W \Delta W turn by turn even as turns still arrive.
The turns arrive in chunks and the stored pairs accumulate into two growing matrices. K ≤ t = [ K 1 , … , K t ] , D ≤ t = [ D 1 , … , D t ] . \begin{split}K_{\leq t}=[K_{1},\dots,K_{t}],\\[3.0pt]

blocks.en:
This work uses LongMemEval ( Wu et al. 2025 ) , a recall benchmark on long user-assistant dialogues whose questions ask about content the user stated many turns earlier.
The evaluation is restricted to the single-session-user subset, where each question is paired to the one earlier turn that holds its answer.
From each retained question the answer-bearing user turn is taken as the fact to store, and numeric-answer questions are removed which leaves 33 non-numeric facts. N N of these turns are written into the parameters and queried by the original held-out question, and recall is reported as N N grows from 4 4 to 32 32 .
The single-session subset supplies only 33 such facts, and N = 32 N{=}32 therefore stores nearly the entire available pool, which places the study at the benchmark’s ceiling rather than at a truncated sample.
Recall is measured at every step from N = 4 N{=}4 to N = 32 N{=}32 .
This shows how much the stored turns interfere as N N increases.
A generation counts as correct when the normalized ground-truth answer is contained in it and when a bidirectional DeBERTa-MNLI gate ( He et al. 2020 ; Williams et al. 2017 ) judges it to entail the ground-truth answer.

Figure 2(a) compares Skim to four reference conditions at N = 32 N{=}32 for five different models.

Here, the models that do not use the KV cache (‘no-cache’) show recall of 3.1 to 15.6%, but this is difficult to regard as recall from the past dialogue because the model answers some questions by prior knowledge or by chance even without the turn.

This indicates that the model can store and recall correctly even when its self-generated questions are used as the keys.
Replacing the answer by self-extracted spans lowers recall by about 26.9% on average for all models, but recall still averages about 63.1%.

blocks.en: Which Stage Fails
blocks.zh: 哪个阶段失败

blocks.en:
For the five models, Figure 3 shows the stage of Skim at which the 32 facts most often fail.
A fact is ‘missing’ when the true answer never enters the extracted span candidates, ‘selection’ when a same-turn rival span is written in its place, ‘routing’ when the user question retrieves a different fact, and ‘decoding’ when the correct value is addressed but the generation breaks down.
Here, ‘missing’ and ‘selection’ are store-time failures, and ‘routing’ and ‘decoding’ are recall-time failures.
The five models produce 59 failures; 22 from span-extraction (missing), 22 from selection, 0 from routing, and 15 from decoding.
Missing and selection account for 44 of the 59 failures, about three quarters of the total.
Most failures therefore occur at store-time rather than at recall.
Decoding accounts for 15 failures and forms the recall-time remainder.
Routing is zero for every model, which indicates that the closed-form keys reach the intended fact and that read-time addressing is never where recall is lost.

The store-time failures split evenly overall, 22 missing and 22 selection in the five-model total.

In all five models, recall on the recent group is lower than on the early and middle groups.
This apparent reduction in recall does not necessarily indicate that recent turns are forgotten.
Every turn is written at the same strength f f described in Eq. 6 , and the edit therefore treats every write position equally.
The lower recall on the recent group instead follows from the answer type carried by those turns, which varies from turn to turn.

Figure 4(b) reports recall by answer type, and the split is sharp.
Proper-noun answers are recalled at 81.1% while descriptive multi-word answers such as "a lighter shade of gray" reach only 36.9%, a difference of about 44 points that largely holds within every position group.
The recent group appears weaker in Figure 4(a) only because it happens to carry more descriptive facts, and the apparent position effect is really an answer-type effect.
A proper noun is a discrete high-salience unit that the model extracts and keys cleanly.
A descriptive span instead has soft boundaries, runs to several tokens, and sits beside same-turn rivals.
Its failure is therefore one of self-extraction and multi-token reproduction rather than of storage or routing.
The hardest facts combine a descriptive answer and a same-turn rival span.
The question-generation stage exists for exactly this structure and concentrates its per-fact gains there by recovering "Golden Retriever" rather than the rival "Max".
The descriptive-answer weakness is thus the clearest lever for improving self-supervision.
It corroborates the earlier finding that self-extraction sets the recall ceiling rather than storage or addressing.

The property depends on re-solving from the base weights each chunk rather than stacking each edit onto the previous one, an additive scheme that allows earlier turns to drift as later ones are written ( Fang et al. 2025 ) .
A streamed dialogue therefore incurs no forgetting, and an earlier turn is recalled no worse once later turns are written on top of it.
This is the position-invariance of Figure 4 (a) read from the write side, and the two jointly show that arrival order changes neither the stored content nor the recalled content.
A growing cache secures this same no-forgetting property only by keeping every turn, whereas the parametric store secures it at a size that stays fixed as the dialogue lengthens.
The re-solve is the one cost that grows, and it runs offline once per chunk.

因此,串流式对话不会忘记,一旦在对话之上写出以后的转折,就会记得以前的转折。

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The main difficulty is the storage of a turn rather than its recall.
Recall of a stored value is near-perfect once that value is written, and Figure 3 shows zero routing failures.
The difficulty is extracting from a turn which content to store without the future question or the answer.
The value harvest scores each candidate span by a self-question and a specificity prior and keeps the top few.
This fails most on descriptive multi-token spans beside same-turn rivals.
The other difficulty is the key rather than the value. Skim keys each span by questions it writes before the real question arrives.
A later question phrased in an unforeseen way leaves its key unformed and its value unrecalled.
A separate limitation is the numeric answer.
A date or a count carries little of the specificity the harvest rewards and is rarely chosen for storage.
A recovered number also seldom reproduces the exact digits the containment metric checks for.
Moreover, prior weight-editing methods operate in a different environment from the one studied here ( Meng et al. 2022a ; Meng et al. 2022b ; Fang et al. 2025 ) .
Running one on a dialogue turn would supply the ground-truth answer and question that this environment does not provide, turning it into an answer-given method rather than a comparable baseline.
The answer-given conditions of Figure 2(a) already serve as that method (see ‘True-Q’), and they mark the recall the correct answer would reach.
blocks.zh:
主要困难是储存转弯而不是召回。
一旦写入存储值,对存储值的召回就接近完美,图3显示零路由故障.
困难是从一个回合中提取,该回合的内容是储存的,没有未来的问题或答案。
收成对每个候选人的评分是自问自问、特异性先行,并保持最高的少数。
这在描述性多键跨度与同转对手之间失败最多。
另一个困难是关键而不是价值。 斯基姆按键每个跨度 由它写的问题 在真正的问题到达之前。
后一个问题用一种无法预料的方式表述,使得其钥匙不成形,其价值不为人所知。
一个单独的限制是数字答案。
一个日期或一个计数带的收获回报的特异性很少,很少被选入储存.
回收的数字也很少复制封存指标检查的确切数字。
此外,先前的加权编辑方法在不同于本文所研究的环境中运作(Meng等人,2022a); 孟 al等编. 2022b; Fang et al. 2025 ).
在对话回合中运行一个将提供这一环境没有提供的地面真相答案和问题,使其成为一个答案给出的方法,而不是一个可比的基准。
图2(a)的答案条件已经作为这种方法(见`True-QQ’'),它们标志着正确答案将达到的召回。

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 有关工作

blocks.en:
Prior training-free methods modify model behavior or stored knowledge without gradient-based retraining ( Meng et al. 2022a ; Fang et al. 2025 ) .
Closed-form weight editing directly modifies selected parameters to store factual associations ( Meng et al. 2022a ; Meng et al. 2022b ) .
ROME rewrites one subject-indexed factual association using a rank-one update to a single feed forward layer ( Meng et al. 2022a ) .
MEMIT extends ROME to many predefined factual associations by distributing the required updates to several feed forward layers, enabling the simultaneous editing of thousands of associations ( Meng et al. 2022b ) .
AlphaEdit constrains each edit to the null space of the preserved knowledge’s keys, which does not affect that knowledge and reduces interference during sequential edits ( Fang et al. 2025 ) .
These methods require predefined edit targets and desired factual outputs ( Meng et al. 2022a ; Meng et al. 2022b ; Fang et al. 2025 ) .
The proposed method constructs both the stored value and its key from the turn itself, taking neither a predefined edit target nor a desired output, and recalls the selected facts in response to later queries phrased differently.
blocks.zh:
以前的无培训方法在不进行梯度再培训的情况下修改模型行为或存储的知识(Meng等人,2022a;Fang等人,2025年)。
闭式重量编辑直接修改选定的参数以存储事实关联(Meng等人,2022a;Meng等人,2022b).
ROME 重写一个主题索引的事实关联,使用一级更新到单一的饲料前进层(Meng等人,2022a) 。 。 。
MEMIT将ROME扩展至许多预先定义的事实关联,将所需的更新发布到几个饲料前传层,从而可以同时编辑数千个关联(Meng等人,2022b.).
AlphaEdit将每次编辑限制在保存的知识键的空格上,这不影响该知识,并减少连续编辑过程中的干扰(Fang等人,2025年).
这些方法要求预先确定编辑目标和预期的实际产出(Meng等人,2022a); 孟 al等编. 2022b; Fang et al. 2025 ).
提议的方法从转弯本身构建存储值及其密钥,既不使用预定义的编辑目标,也不使用期望的输出,并针对后来不同的询问,回顾选定的事实.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en:
This paper studied whether a language model can internalize real dialogue turns into its parameters by one closed-form edit.
The study was conducted in an assumed environment that provides no ground-truth answer and no later question and no external memory, and in a scenario where the dialogue arrives one turn at a time.
The proposed self-keyed in-parameter memorization ( Skim ) extracts what to store from the turn and attaches self-generated questions as its keys. Skim recalls a five-model mean of 63.1% and 75.0% on the strongest model at 32 stored turns, well above a no-cache floor of 3.1 to 15.6%.
The method also shows that streaming the dialogue reaches the same recall performance as storing all turns at once, which means the forgetting caused by sequential storage can be mitigated.
These experimental results show that the proposed Skim stores conversation content in a fixed-size model parameter without any external memory.
blocks.zh:
本文研究了语言模型是否能够通过一个闭式编辑将真实对话内部化,变成其参数.
这项研究是在假定的环境中进行的,没有地面真相答案,没有以后的问题,也没有外部记忆,对话一次一个转弯。
拟议的自键参数内计量(Skim)提取出从转弯处存储的东西,并附上自生成的问题作为其键. Skim回顾了32个存储转弯的最强型号上的5种模式平均值为63.1%和75.0%,远高于3.1%至15.6%的无卡切底.
该方法还表明,流线式对话框达到与同时存储所有转折相同的召回性能,这意味着顺序存储导致的遗忘可以减轻.
这些实验结果表明,拟议的Skim将对话内容存储在一个固定大小的模型参数中,没有任何外部内存.
